metadata.title: Water Economy GIS Prototype Dataset — Catbalogan, Pinabacdao, Calbayog

methodology.households_2024: Estimated by dividing 2024 PSA barangay population by the LGU's PSA 2020 average household size.
methodology.basic_domestic_demand: 55 liters/person/day, midpoint of DPWH's 50–60 L/person/day Level II rural-water design range.
methodology.nrw: 15% design assumption based on DPWH guidance for a new Level II system.
methodology.simulated_economics: Income, water cost, access, reliability, livelihood, outage loss, shortage risk and intervention fields remain synthetic prototype values.

official_sources: PSA Regional Social and Economic Trends, Eastern Visayas (2020 households and average household size)
PSA 2024 POPCEN / PSGC barangay population and urban-rural classification
DPWH Guidelines on Design of Rural Water Supply for Level II (50–60 LPCD; 15% NRW assumption)
DPWH Philippine Green Building Spreadsheet (building water-consumption baselines)
metadata.warning: Derived and simulated fields are prototype estimates, not official engineering, tariff, income, or barangay household statistics.

sector_extension.status: All sector fields are simulated prototype data.
